content: 第一关（前）

speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: Ugh...

speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: Huh? Wh- what happened...?

raw: [name="Vanguard Operator"]   What am I doing here... why am I laying here...?
speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: What am I doing here... why am I laying here...?

raw: [name="Vanguard Operator"]   I remember! We were infiltrating Chernobog to rescue Dr. {@nickname}——
speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: I remember! We were infiltrating Chernobog to rescue Dr. {@nickname}——

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.4, xstrength=8, ystrength=8, vibrato=30, randomness=30, fadeout=true, block=true)]
[name="Vanguard Operator"]   Boss! No, no, the boss, he...
speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: Boss! No, no, the boss, he...

speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: ...Boss...

speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: Huh? What's this paper?

raw: [name="Vanguard Operator"]   Hold up, this... It's Rhodes Island engineering stationary.
speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: Hold up, this... It's Rhodes Island engineering stationary.

raw: [name="Vanguard Operator"]   Who could've left it here? What the hell happened?
speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: Who could've left it here? What the hell happened?

raw: [name="Vanguard Operator"]   Woah, that's a lot of big words, and they're all over the place...
speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: Woah, that's a lot of big words, and they're all over the place...

raw: Operator whose name I do not know, hide yourself well. I had no opportunity to check your nameplate, nor do I remember your name.
content: Operator whose name I do not know, hide yourself well. I had no opportunity to check your nameplate, nor do I remember your name.

raw: Please pardon the hastily scrawled nature of this message, as I am wanting for time. Do me the favor of reading to the end.
content: Please pardon the hastily scrawled nature of this message, as I am wanting for time. Do me the favor of reading to the end.

raw: First, do not fret. You are safe, for the moment.
content: First, do not fret. You are safe, for the moment.

raw: However, you must not, under any circumstances, leave these ruins. The probability of the enemy spotting you before nightfall is quite high.
content: However, you must not, under any circumstances, leave these ruins. The probability of the enemy spotting you before nightfall is quite high.

raw: To put it simply, you are at present completely surrounded by the enemy.
content: To put it simply, you are at present completely surrounded by the enemy.

raw: [name="Vanguard Operator"]   This isn't the boss's handwriting... did it even come from Rhodes Island?
speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: This isn't the boss's handwriting... did it even come from Rhodes Island?

raw: [name="Vanguard Operator"]   They sure wrote a lot. Why didn't they just wake me up and tell me——
speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: They sure wrote a lot. Why didn't they just wake me up and tell me——
You came.

raw: [name="Vanguard Operator"]   (Huh? A voice? Is it Reunion? Shit!)
speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: (Huh? A voice? Is it Reunion? Shit!)

raw: [name="Vanguard Operator"]   (...No, wait, it sounds familiar. It's that guy from the clinic——)
speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: (...No, wait, it sounds familiar. It's that guy from the clinic——)

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   You have managed to completely paralyze Chernobog. I am not sure whether I should be congratulating you.
speaker: Hellagur
content: You have managed to completely paralyze Chernobog. I am not sure whether I should be congratulating you.

speaker: Hellagur
content: We have both contracted Oripathy.
It truly is you.

raw: [name="???"]   I thought. It was just rumors.
content: I thought. It was just rumors.

speaker: Hellagur
content: It's been years, Buldrokkas'tee.

speaker: Hellagur
content: Or is it 'Patriot' now?

speaker: Patriot
content: So. You remember me.

speaker: Patriot
content: ...General.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   Were it not for you charging so boldly into the fortress with that shield of yours, Barclay, Semyon, and I would surely have died at the hands of Kazimierz's Silverlance, Pegasus Order of Knighthood.
speaker: Hellagur
content: Were it not for you charging so boldly into the fortress with that shield of yours, Barclay, Semyon, and I would surely have died at the hands of Kazimierz's Silverlance, Pegasus Order of Knighthood.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   My warriors. Are brave. Do not fear sacrifice.
speaker: Patriot
content: My warriors. Are brave. Do not fear sacrifice.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   Hm. Your manner of speech is quite different now than it was years ago.
speaker: Hellagur
content: Hm. Your manner of speech is quite different now than it was years ago.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   I once witnessed you rousing the troops with your rhetoric, driving even Barclay the Bald Butcher to cheer your name. No easy feat.
speaker: Hellagur
content: I once witnessed you rousing the troops with your rhetoric, driving even Barclay the Bald Butcher to cheer your name. No easy feat.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   The infection. Changed my vocal cords. Now. It is difficult. For me to speak. Fluently. Ridiculous.
speaker: Patriot
content: The infection. Changed my vocal cords. Now. It is difficult. For me to speak. Fluently. Ridiculous.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   As is this identity you have constructed.
speaker: Hellagur
content: As is this identity you have constructed.

speaker: Patriot
content: Oh?

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   So, the Northern Tundra Guerrillas... that was you leading them. I never would have imagined you could be running around with dozens of Wendigos.
speaker: Hellagur
content: So, the Northern Tundra Guerrillas... that was you leading them. I never would have imagined you could be running around with dozens of Wendigos.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   That cavalry commander, Alyosha Bluebeard, he made a bet with me that you would become Grand Marshal of the Ursus Army.
speaker: Hellagur
content: That cavalry commander, Alyosha Bluebeard, he made a bet with me that you would become Grand Marshal of the Ursus Army.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Just staff captain, General. Times have changed.
speaker: Patriot
content: Just staff captain, General. Times have changed.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   ...I was jesting. But your loyalty, your record, and the plans you would devise in our staff meetings... You truly were one of the finest officers in all of Ursus.
speaker: Hellagur
content: ...I was jesting. But your loyalty, your record, and the plans you would devise in our staff meetings... You truly were one of the finest officers in all of Ursus.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   You go too far. I am Sarkaz, after all.
speaker: Patriot
content: You go too far. I am Sarkaz, after all.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   If someone like you couldn't become colonel, the entire Ursus High Command should have been court-martialed.
speaker: Hellagur
content: If someone like you couldn't become colonel, the entire Ursus High Command should have been court-martialed.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   Of course, most of them are long dead.
speaker: Hellagur
content: Of course, most of them are long dead.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Then, I have outlasted them. Your colleagues, are mostly dead.
speaker: Patriot
content: Then, I have outlasted them. Your colleagues, are mostly dead.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   And, His Majesty said, the army serves the country. Not their careers.
speaker: Patriot
content: And, His Majesty said, the army serves the country. Not their careers.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   He also once said it is not blood that binds the Ursus people together, but conviction. What of that now? I can only hope His Majesty is ready to rest in peace.
speaker: Hellagur
content: He also once said it is not blood that binds the Ursus people together, but conviction. What of that now? I can only hope His Majesty is ready to rest in peace.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   All our recent Emperors have seen you as nothing more than monsters. You are not Ursus warriors to them. They have done everything they can to oppress your people.
speaker: Hellagur
content: All our recent Emperors have seen you as nothing more than monsters. You are not Ursus warriors to them. They have done everything they can to oppress your people.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   That one, more enlightened Emperor. Has already passed. This, I understand.
speaker: Patriot
content: That one, more enlightened Emperor. Has already passed. This, I understand.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   The war beasts. Of Ursus. Could drown the world, with their numbers. I am not special.
speaker: Patriot
content: The war beasts. Of Ursus. Could drown the world, with their numbers. I am not special.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   Then it is not because of the Army that you left.
speaker: Hellagur
content: Then it is not because of the Army that you left.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Correct. I do not care. I want only to stand, shoulder to shoulder. With my warriors.
speaker: Patriot
content: Correct. I do not care. I want only to stand, shoulder to shoulder. With my warriors.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   General, sit. Drink, with me. I have some. From the north.
speaker: Patriot
content: General, sit. Drink, with me. I have some. From the north.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   ...Time grows short. Let us save it for next time.
speaker: Hellagur
content: ...Time grows short. Let us save it for next time.

speaker: Patriot
content: Oh... Very well.

speaker: Patriot
content: No matter.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Go to 4th street. Find survivors. Do not threaten them. Minimize casualties. Look for supplies. Our stocks, are low, as always.
speaker: Patriot
content: Go to 4th street. Find survivors. Do not threaten them. Minimize casualties. Look for supplies. Our stocks, are low, as always.

speaker: Reunion Troops
content: Yes, sir!

speaker: Patriot
content: I feared you dead.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   Life underground is a sort of death. Who I am today has little to do with who I was.
speaker: Hellagur
content: Life underground is a sort of death. Who I am today has little to do with who I was.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   You hide, here? Less than ideal.
speaker: Patriot
content: You hide, here? Less than ideal.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   Chernobog has long been uninhabitable. The Catastrophe makes little difference to that effect.
speaker: Hellagur
content: Chernobog has long been uninhabitable. The Catastrophe makes little difference to that effect.

speaker: Patriot
content: Seems you must leave.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   The clinic has been extensively looted. We evacuated beforehand, but the loss is still substantial.
speaker: Hellagur
content: The clinic has been extensively looted. We evacuated beforehand, but the loss is still substantial.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   It was only after I heard the rumors of your presence that I decided to stay here and see for myself.
speaker: Hellagur
content: It was only after I heard the rumors of your presence that I decided to stay here and see for myself.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   I do not deserve, such attention. It is dangerous, here.
speaker: Patriot
content: I do not deserve, such attention. It is dangerous, here.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   I wanted only to see how one of my few remaining brothers has weathered the years.
speaker: Hellagur
content: I wanted only to see how one of my few remaining brothers has weathered the years.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   You did not. Those ties broke. Long ago.
speaker: Patriot
content: You did not. Those ties broke. Long ago.

speaker: Hellagur
content: Hmph...

raw: [name="Patriot"]   ...I will find out, who did it. Your clinic. That was, an aberration.
speaker: Patriot
content: ...I will find out, who did it. Your clinic. That was, an aberration.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   There is no need. At least, with you here, it is very unlikely that Reunion is responsible.
speaker: Hellagur
content: There is no need. At least, with you here, it is very unlikely that Reunion is responsible.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   I cannot be sure. Reunion, can be, hard to control. There are some, communication barriers.
speaker: Patriot
content: I cannot be sure. Reunion, can be, hard to control. There are some, communication barriers.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Still, General. You could join, Reunion.
speaker: Patriot
content: Still, General. You could join, Reunion.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   If Ursus was, to be liberated. Then the Infected, and the others, could live. As equals.
speaker: Patriot
content: If Ursus was, to be liberated. Then the Infected, and the others, could live. As equals.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   Look here. Look around us. Look at this building impaled by Originium.
speaker: Hellagur
content: Look here. Look around us. Look at this building impaled by Originium.

speaker: Patriot
content: I see it.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   This was once a shopping mall. All the people in a three block radius depended on this building for their very survival.
speaker: Hellagur
content: This was once a shopping mall. All the people in a three block radius depended on this building for their very survival.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   The Catastrophe. Destroyed Chernobog. Destroyed the fortress, destroyed the city. I do not agree with, the methods. But this was, necessary. We had, no choice.
speaker: Patriot
content: The Catastrophe. Destroyed Chernobog. Destroyed the fortress, destroyed the city. I do not agree with, the methods. But this was, necessary. We had, no choice.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   It was not long ago that the clocktower was done up in colorful lights. Another dazzling array hung over the intersection below, bathing it in a warm glow.
speaker: Hellagur
content: It was not long ago that the clocktower was done up in colorful lights. Another dazzling array hung over the intersection below, bathing it in a warm glow.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   The Infected, had no right, to enjoy those lights.
speaker: Patriot
content: The Infected, had no right, to enjoy those lights.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   You want to make the lights glow again, and I simply want to build another market. This is the difference between us.
speaker: Hellagur
content: You want to make the lights glow again, and I simply want to build another market. This is the difference between us.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   ——There was a time. When you would not. Compromise like this.
speaker: Patriot
content: ——There was a time. When you would not. Compromise like this.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   Perhaps. There may not be such a bright future at Rhodes Island, but I cannot say I feel much for this place either.
speaker: Hellagur
content: Perhaps. There may not be such a bright future at Rhodes Island, but I cannot say I feel much for this place either.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   You simply do not, wish to fight your motherland. General.
speaker: Patriot
content: You simply do not, wish to fight your motherland. General.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Look at this city. Look at the Infected. Look at the mall, ruined by Originium. Look at the dead.
speaker: Patriot
content: Look at this city. Look at the Infected. Look at the mall, ruined by Originium. Look at the dead.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   And you. You have never, been afraid, to get your hands dirty.
speaker: Patriot
content: And you. You have never, been afraid, to get your hands dirty.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   Correct. Should Ursus move violently against us, we will not hesitate to fight back.
speaker: Hellagur
content: Correct. Should Ursus move violently against us, we will not hesitate to fight back.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   But Reunion's actions are rather outside my idea of fighting back. Look at this broken city beneath our feet——Reunion is provoking a war.
speaker: Hellagur
content: But Reunion's actions are rather outside my idea of fighting back. Look at this broken city beneath our feet——Reunion is provoking a war.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   And how many people would die in such a war? How many Ursus lives would a civil war cost?
speaker: Hellagur
content: And how many people would die in such a war? How many Ursus lives would a civil war cost?

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   Imagine it. The Ursus devouring itself. Massacring itself. Obliterating itself.
speaker: Hellagur
content: Imagine it. The Ursus devouring itself. Massacring itself. Obliterating itself.

speaker: Patriot
content: General.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   What if, the Ursus, treated the Infected, as Ursus?
speaker: Patriot
content: What if, the Ursus, treated the Infected, as Ursus?

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Then, there would be, no war.
speaker: Patriot
content: Then, there would be, no war.

speaker: Reunion Soldier
content: Excuse me.

speaker: Patriot
content: What?

raw: [name="Reunion Soldier"]   Reporting in. The leadership has made a statement: Chernobog is now completely under our control. We are broadcasting on all frequencies.
speaker: Reunion Soldier
content: Reporting in. The leadership has made a statement: Chernobog is now completely under our control. We are broadcasting on all frequencies.

raw: [name="Reunion Soldier"]   The leadership has asked for a situation report from each division.
speaker: Reunion Soldier
content: The leadership has asked for a situation report from each division.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Right. I'll take care of it.
speaker: Patriot
content: Right. I'll take care of it.

speaker: Patriot
content: Sorry, General. Wait a minute.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   Does Reunion truly understand what they are doing?
speaker: Hellagur
content: Does Reunion truly understand what they are doing?

raw: [name="Reunion Soldier"]   How am I supposed to answer you, old man?
speaker: Reunion Soldier
content: How am I supposed to answer you, old man?

raw: [name="Reunion Soldier"]   Or were you not really asking? I guess all I can say is we're following the commander.
speaker: Reunion Soldier
content: Or were you not really asking? I guess all I can say is we're following the commander.

raw: [name="Reunion Soldier"]   No matter what the commander does, we're behind him.
speaker: Reunion Soldier
content: No matter what the commander does, we're behind him.

raw: [name="Reunion Soldier"]   If it's right, he'll do it. If it's wrong, he'll change.
speaker: Reunion Soldier
content: If it's right, he'll do it. If it's wrong, he'll change.

raw: [name="Reunion Soldier"]   We believe in Talulah and we believe in the commander. We fight for the Infected. Got it?
speaker: Reunion Soldier
content: We believe in Talulah and we believe in the commander. We fight for the Infected. Got it?

speaker: Patriot
content: General.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   Reunion has won a great victory. And yet I do not detect any joy in your voice.
speaker: Hellagur
content: Reunion has won a great victory. And yet I do not detect any joy in your voice.

speaker: Patriot
content: Should I be? Happy...?

raw: [name="Patriot"]   If the Ursus will it, any city, will be flattened.
speaker: Patriot
content: If the Ursus will it, any city, will be flattened.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Such an outcome, is most challenging. This battle, it confuses me. The Ursus response.
speaker: Patriot
content: Such an outcome, is most challenging. This battle, it confuses me. The Ursus response.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   The war has already begun. There is no turning back now.
speaker: Hellagur
content: The war has already begun. There is no turning back now.

speaker: Patriot
content: Perhaps. I have been foolish.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   However, if I do nothing. The chains of the Infected, will grow heavier.
speaker: Patriot
content: However, if I do nothing. The chains of the Infected, will grow heavier.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Should we lose, our conception of the struggle, we move toward annihilation.
speaker: Patriot
content: Should we lose, our conception of the struggle, we move toward annihilation.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   So you do understand the situation. You do know what you have done.
speaker: Hellagur
content: So you do understand the situation. You do know what you have done.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Yes. We are, fighting for our lives.
speaker: Patriot
content: Yes. We are, fighting for our lives.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   Then I have no further questions.
speaker: Hellagur
content: Then I have no further questions.

speaker: Reunion Soldier
content: Reporting in!

speaker: Patriot
content: Subcity Sector 3, damage report?

speaker: Reunion Soldier
content: Yes, sir!

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Spare me the details. Save the civilians. It is dangerous. Protect yourselves. Don't be heroes.
speaker: Patriot
content: Spare me the details. Save the civilians. It is dangerous. Protect yourselves. Don't be heroes.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Bring a caster. Use drones to scout. That's what they're for.
speaker: Patriot
content: Bring a caster. Use drones to scout. That's what they're for.

speaker: Reunion Soldier
content: Understood!

speaker: Patriot
content: Right...

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Where is it, you plan to go?
speaker: Patriot
content: Where is it, you plan to go?

speaker: Hellagur
content: Rhodes Island

speaker: Patriot
content: Ah, I see. Rhodes Island.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   But. Reunion has just. Attacked Rhodes Island.
speaker: Patriot
content: But. Reunion has just. Attacked Rhodes Island.

speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: Why you...

raw: [name="Vanguard Operator"]   Amiya and Dobermann, I hope they're okay...
speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: Amiya and Dobermann, I hope they're okay...

raw: [name="Vanguard Operator"]   What should I do? What can I do right now...?
speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: What should I do? What can I do right now...?

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   ——If they move into Chernobog at a time like this, everyone would view Rhodes Island as an enemy.
speaker: Hellagur
content: ——If they move into Chernobog at a time like this, everyone would view Rhodes Island as an enemy.

speaker: Hellagur
content: Why would they do this?

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Unclear. But, there is nothing I can do, to stop the conflict.
speaker: Patriot
content: Unclear. But, there is nothing I can do, to stop the conflict.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   We just had a warrior. Fighting alone. A Sarkaz mercenary.
speaker: Patriot
content: We just had a warrior. Fighting alone. A Sarkaz mercenary.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   And, the one from, Rhodes Island, was also Sarkaz.
speaker: Patriot
content: And, the one from, Rhodes Island, was also Sarkaz.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   The same sort of misery... There is no difference between them and Reunion.
speaker: Hellagur
content: The same sort of misery... There is no difference between them and Reunion.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   The masses. Fooled by the Ursus. But to us, we are compatriots.
speaker: Patriot
content: The masses. Fooled by the Ursus. But to us, we are compatriots.

raw: [name="Vanguard Operator"]   Huh? A Sarkaz... from Rhodes Island?
speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: Huh? A Sarkaz... from Rhodes Island?

raw: [name="Patriot"]   But a mercenary. Fights for fighting's sake. Rhodes Island's warrior. Has a reason to fight.
speaker: Patriot
content: But a mercenary. Fights for fighting's sake. Rhodes Island's warrior. Has a reason to fight.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   He lost. But he shot dead, many elite troops. The new mercenary captain, was at a loss.
speaker: Patriot
content: He lost. But he shot dead, many elite troops. The new mercenary captain, was at a loss.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   And, the enemy. He led away from the ruins.
speaker: Patriot
content: And, the enemy. He led away from the ruins.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   He wanted to hide something. He did.
speaker: Patriot
content: He wanted to hide something. He did.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   In the ashes. Was this thing. Please, return it to them.
speaker: Patriot
content: In the ashes. Was this thing. Please, return it to them.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   A true warrior... with no name.
speaker: Patriot
content: A true warrior... with no name.

speaker: Hellagur
content: I will.

raw: [name="Vanguard Operator"]   A Sarkaz... Don't tell me that was Scout protecting me...?
speaker: Vanguard Operator
content: A Sarkaz... Don't tell me that was Scout protecting me...?

speaker: Hellagur
content: A true warrior...

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   Yes. You have said as much before.
speaker: Hellagur
content: Yes. You have said as much before.

speaker: Patriot
content: Go on.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   Thirty some years ago, you wanted to have a test of sorts with me.
speaker: Hellagur
content: Thirty some years ago, you wanted to have a test of sorts with me.

speaker: Patriot
content: Now? No longer.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   My armor. You could not pierce it. It would be unfair.
speaker: Patriot
content: My armor. You could not pierce it. It would be unfair.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   This armor is well past its prime. A far cry from the days when the Army performed regular maintenance on it.
speaker: Hellagur
content: This armor is well past its prime. A far cry from the days when the Army performed regular maintenance on it.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   My armor, is Ursus. I am a, traitor to the Empire. It will deteriorate. More and more.
speaker: Patriot
content: My armor, is Ursus. I am a, traitor to the Empire. It will deteriorate. More and more.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   And that is why you bear the name you do. When the Empire has done wrong, you stand up to her.
speaker: Hellagur
content: And that is why you bear the name you do. When the Empire has done wrong, you stand up to her.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   I cannot say, General. I did not choose, this name.
speaker: Patriot
content: I cannot say, General. I did not choose, this name.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   'Patriot,' is war with Ursus the correct course of action?
speaker: Hellagur
content: 'Patriot,' is war with Ursus the correct course of action?

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Naturally. Our war, is righteous. If not, the countless sacrifices. Were in vain.
speaker: Patriot
content: Naturally. Our war, is righteous. If not, the countless sacrifices. Were in vain.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   General. We both know, the true solution.
speaker: Patriot
content: General. We both know, the true solution.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   But they must not, die in vain. Their deaths. Must have meaning.
speaker: Patriot
content: But they must not, die in vain. Their deaths. Must have meaning.

raw: [name="Hellagur"]   But you have already risen up, against Ursus.
speaker: Hellagur
content: But you have already risen up, against Ursus.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   What I oppose. Is the Empire. Not the land. Not the people. Not Ursus itself.
speaker: Patriot
content: What I oppose. Is the Empire. Not the land. Not the people. Not Ursus itself.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   If the Minister of Medicine. Did this. He is our enemy.
speaker: Patriot
content: If the Minister of Medicine. Did this. He is our enemy.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   If a conspiracy, of the legislature. We overthrow the legislature.
speaker: Patriot
content: If a conspiracy, of the legislature. We overthrow the legislature.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   If the Army, fabricated resistance. We destroy the army.
speaker: Patriot
content: If the Army, fabricated resistance. We destroy the army.

raw: [name="Patriot"]   Talulah's goals are broad. Far-reaching. Mine are localized. And specific.
